Exact native owner, callback identity/removal/registration, actor position/velocity, level tick and nonforcing physical chunk status/entity-ticking are observations only. No forced chunks. Bound messages and explicit truncation; keep full final body facts in logs and compact assertion text. Focused author checks and independent review precede submission. This is diagnosis, not a continuity fix, full regression or readiness.
